text: I am glad that you have decided to work purposefully for a month with the theme of wisdom, or more precisely with the complex of emotional and bodily states associated with the harmoniousness of the fourth chakra. We will direct attention not only to the development of intellectual qualities (memory, logic, analysis...), but also to the ability to foresee, to intuit, to retain reason and calm in moments of vivid emotional involvement. Over the course of 30 days you will receive 30 practices aimed at harmonizing the sixth chakra. Read this letter carefully so that you understand what will happen and how.
